name: Golden Hearts & Crimson Souls
source:
Welcome to Drahoskivi! Play as Judie Amber, runaway captain of the Amber army charged falsely with treason and murder, or as Markus Carnelian, the man who so happens to find her and decides to help her in her pursuit.

[From [url=https://celestial-toast.itch.io/golden-hearts-crimson-souls] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到德拉霍斯基维！扮演朱迪·安布尔（Judie Amber），被错误指控犯有叛国罪和谋杀罪的安珀军队的逃亡队长，或者扮演马库斯·卡内利安（Markus Carnelian），他碰巧找到了她，并决定帮助她追捕她。

[来自[url=https://celestial-toast.itch.io/golden-hearts-crimson-souls] itch.io[/url]]
